$comment: Controller support (docs/GAMEPAD.md): the W3C Standard Gamepad's buttons and sticks, what each action is bound to by default, and the tunables. The actions are a fixed vocabulary in code (crates/dwell-game/src/gamepad.rs for play, client/src/input/gamepadMenu.ts for menus); which button each one is on is data, and players rebind them in Settings → Controller (kept per browser, dwell.gamepad). Run `node shared/input/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-game/src/gamepad.gen.rs or client/src/input/gamepad.gen.ts is stale.

sticks.$comment: Axes of the standard mapping: the left stick moves (and moves the menu's focus), the right one looks.

play.$comment: While playing (no menu open). Held: jump (and fly up), crouch (and fly down), run (pressed once, it holds until the stick lets go). Pressed: the rest.

menu.$comment: While a menu is open: move the focus (the left stick too), press the focused control, go back or close.

tunables.$comment: deadzone: stick travel (0–1) read as rest. lookDegPerS: the view's turn at full right-stick tilt (°/s), scaled by the player's look speed. lookCurve: the tilt's response exponent (1 linear; 2 fine aim near the centre). triggerThreshold: how far a trigger is pressed to count. menuRepeatMs, menuRepeatDelayMs: a held direction moves the menu's focus again every menuRepeatMs after the first menuRepeatDelayMs.
